legs: Single continuous camera move, no cuts. The man smiles and rolls the plans flat across the table; the camera pushes in slowly past him and down over the blueprint until the paper fills the frame, and the lines of the central section begin to glow a warm mystical gold, gold motes rising off the paper.

Single continuous magical camera move, no cuts. The camera keeps pushing down into the glowing gold plan; the gold lines rise and grow up out of the paper, the drawing unfolds and turns into the real village, and the camera emerges flying high above the twelve white homes on the green hillside in morning mist with the lake beyond.
